description: List one of your functions on the marketplace: pass function_id, and optionally is_public (default false), commission_rate (default 0.30), min_payout_threshold (default 50) and payout_currency (default USD). A listing made public is reviewed first; a function that fails the review is saved private and the refusal carries the report. Where payouts go is set by a person, not by this tool. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

commission_rate.description: The share of each sale the marketplace keeps. Defaults to 0.30.

function_id.description: The pricing function UUID: id on a list_functions result.

is_public.description: List it publicly. Defaults to false.

min_payout_threshold.description: The least balance that is paid out. Defaults to 50.

payout_currency.description: The currency payouts are made in. Defaults to USD.

name: create_marketplace_listing
